relevance_note: The paper labels 14 PSTPIP1 carriers individually, e.g. "In patients P1 to P13, the heterozygous G>A transition at the c.748 position" and "In patient P14 the heterozygous G>A transition at c.769 position".
method_note: Rows written by a short Python script from my own reading of the main text; no table was transcribed (the per-patient Tables E1-E5 and supplementary files are not in the Markdown, only their titles). Scope: the 14 Hz/Hc patients P1-P14 (PSTPIP1 p.E250K or p.E257K) get rows. The 11 PAPA control patients (8 p.A230T, 2 p.E250Q, 1 p.E256G; Table E2) are described only at group level; PI and PII are named only as previously reported, with no individual-level fact beyond diagnosis, and variants cannot be assigned to them, so they get no rows (counted in n_patients_reported = 14 + 11 = 25, a sum of two stated counts). SJIA, FMF and healthy controls are out of scope; the paper states no single study total, so cohort_size_as_stated is null. P1 (ref 2), P2 (ref 13), P3 (ref 14), P4 (ref 15) and P11 (ref 21) are previously reported but are described first-hand here, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported' and the mapping is in publications.prior_report_citation. Variants: the cDNA is printed only as prose ('G>A transition at the c.748 position'; 'G>A transition at c.769 position'), not as HGVS, so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null and the prose is the original string; protein p.E250K / p.E257K in their own field. No transcript printed. Inheritance: parental DNA for P2-P8, P12 and P13 'confirmed a de novo mutation in 8 patients' without naming them; P8 shares E250K with his father P9, so P8 is recorded inherited paternal. I did not assign 'de novo' to the other eight by elimination; their inheritance is 'not reported' with the parental-testing sentence quoted. Functional evidence (pyrin binding, hyperphosphorylation) was tested for E250K only, so it is filled for P1-P13; E257K had only in-silico electrostatic modelling, left 'not reported' for P14. Pathogenicity 'very likely deleterious' is stated for both named variants. Group statements used for observed features: 'In all patients carrying the mutations, we detected excessively increased MRP8/14 and zinc serum levels' (hyperzincemia, hypercalprotectinemia) and 'neutropenia (14/14)' / 'neutropenia, which is present in all patients' (neutropenia), applied to all 14. Other cohort features are counts without names (e.g. anemia 13/14, thrombocytopenia 7/14, arthritis 7/14, failure to thrive 9/14, hepatosplenomegaly 12/14, two deaths) and are 'not reported' per person. Inconsistencies noted: MRP8/14 mean is 2045 +/- 1300 ug/mL in the Abstract but 2070 +/- 1190 ug/mL in Results; Fig 4 gives Hz/Hc n = 13 while the text says MRP8/14 and zinc were increased in all patients carrying the mutations; the text says P1 had 'pyoderma gangrenosum (Fig 2, C)' while the Fig 1 legend calls panel C 'pyoderma gangrenosum-like ulcers'; Table E3 is cited both for anti-neutrophil antibodies and for the cytokine profile.
